Lead enterprise-wide AI, automation and digital transformation initiatives for a growing Adelaide organisation   
  Your New Company  
 Our client is a highly successful Australian organisation with a national footprint and a strong growth trajectory. Operating in a complex, fast-paced environment, the business is investing heavily in digital capability, automation, AI, and enterprise technology to drive operational excellence and commercial performance. 
 This newly created executive leadership role offers the opportunity to shape the future direction of the organisation by identifying, delivering, and embedding transformative technology initiatives that create measurable business outcomes. 
   
  Your New Role  
  Reporting to the executive leadership team, you will lead the organisation's digital transformation agenda, with a strong focus on delivering tangible commercial outcomes through AI, automation, systems integration, data, and technology-enabled change. 
   
 This is far more than a traditional IT leadership role. You will act as a strategic business transformation leader, identifying emerging technologies and translating them into practical opportunities that improve profitability, productivity, customer engagement, and operational performance. 
   
  Key responsibilities include:  
 
 
 Driving the organisation's digital transformation strategy and roadmap. 
 
 
 Delivering AI and automation initiatives with measurable ROI and business impact. 
 
 
 Leading large-scale enterprise programs across ERP, CRM, data, integration, reporting, and customer platforms. 
 
 
 Developing and presenting business cases to executive and board-level stakeholders. 
 
 
 Leading organisational change and ensuring successful adoption of new technologies and ways of working. 
 
 
 Providing strategic oversight of enterprise architecture, cybersecurity, infrastructure resilience, and technology governance. 
 
 
 Partnering with senior executives to identify new opportunities for innovation, efficiency, and growth. 
 
 
 Managing technology vendors, delivery partners, and internal technology teams. 
 
 
 Supporting acquisition and integration activities through scalable technology and data strategies. 
 
 
   
  What You'll Need to Succeed  
 To be successful in this role, you will bring a combination of commercial leadership, digital transformation expertise, and strong technical fluency.   
 You will demonstrate: 
 
 
 Proven experience leading enterprise-wide digital transformation initiatives. 
 
 
 A track record of delivering AI and automation solutions into production with measurable commercial outcomes. 
 
 
 Strong financial and commercial acumen, including experience developing and defending business cases with executive stakeholders. 
 
 
 Experience driving behavioural change and technology adoption across large and complex organisations. 
 
 
 Technical credibility across cloud platforms, systems integration, data architecture, cybersecurity, and enterprise applications. 
 
 
 Exceptional stakeholder engagement and influencing skills, with the ability to communicate effectively at both executive and operational levels. 
 
 
 Experience leading cross-functional technology, project, and business teams. 
 
 
 A genuine passion for emerging technologies and a demonstrated ability to stay at the forefront of industry trends. 
 
 
   
  What You'll Get in Return  
   
 In return, you will secure a rare opportunity to lead transformation at an enterprise scale and directly influence the future direction of a growing organisation. 
   
 You will enjoy: 
 
 A highly visible executive leadership position. 
 The opportunity to shape and execute a genuine digital transformation strategy. 
 Significant investment in technology, AI, automation, and innovation initiatives. 
 Direct exposure to executive and board-level decision-making. 
 The ability to deliver meaningful commercial outcomes and leave a lasting impact on the organisation. 
 A competitive executive remuneration package. 
 
   
  What to Do Next  
  If this sounds like the right opportunity for you, click 'Apply Now' to send your updated CV to  Bradley.lucas@hays.com.au  or call on 0872214159 for a confidential chat.  Please  click here  to apply.

result.description:
At WHOOP, we're on a mission to unlock human performance. WHOOP, a leader in the wearable tech space, empowers its members to perform at a higher level through a deeper understanding of their bodies and daily lives.

WHOOP is seeking a Marketing Director, ANZ - to own and execute a fully integrated regional marketing and commercial strategy that drives brand affinity and omni-channel growth. This role serves as the executional owner for the ANZ region, with responsibility for translating global strategies into regionally relevant, culturally resonant programs. Operating with a high degree of autonomy, this role partners closely with cross-functional teams to align strategy, execution, and performance across the ANZ markets.

JOB RESPONSIBILITIES:

? Own execution and performance of regional omni-channel commercial targets, translating strategic marketing and sales plans into outcomes that deliver both brand and business KPIs.

? Develop and execute integrated marketing campaigns that align WHOOP with key cultural moments, regional trends, and community-driven movements, particularly within fitness, wellness, sports, and lifestyle verticals.

? Identify and activate opportunities around mainstream cultural events (e.g., major sporting events, holidays, industry conferences) to deepen brand relevance and drive buzz at local and national levels.

? Lead cross-functional collaboration with Brand, Social, and Partnerships teams to amplify culturally relevant storytelling and ensure cohesive brand messaging across channels.

? Build and maintain strategic relationships with local fitness studios, athletic organizations, wellness influencers, and community leaders to authentically embed WHOOP within target communities.

? Own WHOOP’s grassroots presence in key cities by planning and executing on-the-ground activations, pop-ups, brand experiences, and community events that drive member acquisition, product engagement, and loyalty.

? Own analysis and reporting on campaign impact, community growth, and regional performance to inform future initiatives and improve effectiveness.

? Own regional media strategy and execution in partnership with global leads to ensure effective channel mix and budget allocation.

? Collaborate on regional influencer, creator, and affiliate partnerships to increase brand visibility and conversion.

? Support wholesale expansion and optimise channel performance in coordination with internal sales and trade marketing teams.

? Localise global brand campaigns and creative assets, ensuring cultural nuance, seasonality and alignment with ANZ market dynamics.

? Activate sports and talent marketing strategies within ANZ, identifying opportunities for regional relevance and performance impact.

? Execute global and regional partnerships, product launches, and PR campaigns to drive engagement and cultural connection in the ANZ market.

QUALIFICATIONS

? 8+ years of experience in marketing, including ownership of regional initiatives, preferably within consumer tech, fitness, wellness, or lifestyle brands.

? Bachelor’s degree in Marketing, Communications or a closely related field

? Deep understanding of the ANZ market - media, commercial and competitive landscapes- with demonstrated cultural fluency and insight into consumer behaviour.

? Proven experience across influencer marketing, media planning, and brand partnerships.

? Strong analytical skills with the ability to interpret commercial performance data and inform strategic decisions.

? Demonstrated ability to lead complex initiatives through cross-functional collaboration and influence.

? Critical thinker with great problem solving abilities to identify areas of opportunity and improvement on a consistent basis.

? Strong relationship management and communication skills, comfortable holding both partners and internal stakeholders accountable

? Team player but works well independently to balance looking at the larger picture at hand with prioritisation of day to day initiatives.

? Adaptable and thrives in a dynamic and fast moving business

? Is comfortable with constant change, is self motivated and collaborative.

? Demonstrated passion for performance, wellness, and WHOOP’s mission.

LEVEL RESPONSIBILITIES:

? Expertise: Expert at core job responsibilities, seen as an expert/leader by other peers. Solves large, complex problems independently and leads company-wide projects and cross-functional efforts with little guidance

? Collaboration: Establishes clear direction for the team and leads the execution

? Communication: Expresses complicated issues simply to others. Solicits and integrates feedback to improve performance with limited guidance; proactively remedies communication issues

? Influence: Effectively manages cross-functional leads to increase marketing impact for the country. Influences other dept. leaders to increase team impact, while setting and maintaining high standards for team results and output

? Innovation: Consistently looking for new ways to approach and improve work.

Role Purpose:
This aluminium welder position involves using various techniques, like MIG and TIG welding, to join aluminium parts according to specifications and blueprints. They are responsible for preparing materials, inspecting welds, maintaining equipment, and ensuring safety and quality standards are met. This role often requires physical stamina, dexterity, and the ability to work in diverse environments. 

Key Responsibilities:
•	Knowledge and experience: Fabricating mild steel, stainless steel and aluminium components, products, and structures with MIG and TIG welding.
•	Material Preparation: Cutting, grinding, and preparing aluminium materials for welding. 
•	Equipment Operation and Maintenance: Operating and maintaining welding machines and equipment, including changing parts and ensuring proper functioning. 
•	Inspection and Quality Control: Inspecting welds for quality, adherence to safety regulations, and dimensional accuracy. 
•	Safety Compliance: Following all safety procedures and guidelines related to welding and material handling. 
•	Documentation: Maintaining records of work performed and materials used. 
•	Collaboration: Working with other welders, fabricators, and engineers to understand project requirements and ensure successful completion. 
•	Material Handling: Moving and storing finished products as needed. 

Essential skills needed:
•	Trade Certificate in Welding and/or 3+ years’ experience in welding.
•	Expertise knowledge of fabricating a variety of components, products, or structures (not just
production welding).
•	Thorough understanding of aluminium properties and welding characteristics.
•	Sound knowledge of Workplace Health and Safety requirements.
•	Physical Stamina - Ability to perform repetitive tasks and work in various positions
•	Physical Dexterity - Ability to handle tools and materials with precision
•	Supply & maintain own commercial grade tools, noting a tool maintenance allowance is included in the salary package.
•	Provide own vehicle to get themselves and their tools to site.
•	Maintain current driver’s license (manual preferred).

About You:
•	Ability to manage own time to meet agreed timeframe and projects.
•	Able to work on tasks autonomously or in a team.
•	Demonstrates a positive, willingness to learn and ability to follow directions from managers requirements.
•	Hard working and reliable.
•	Attention to detail and able to work to deadlines.

What you need to do now:
If you are interested and have the experience, we would love to hear from you!

Please click the 'APPLY' button now and send through your resume and cover letter detailing your previous relevant experience and why you are the perfect candidate for our team.

Please note, due to the high number of applications we expect to receive, we will only be responding to applicants who have been successful in securing an interview.

Additional Information:
Valid Qualification means:  Welder (First Class) - ANZSCO Skill Level 3: the occupation requires a high level of skill and expertise, typically associated with AQF Certificate III and at least two years of on-the-job training or an AQF Certificate IV. 

Tasks include:
•	Manufacturing items from start to finish, including measuring, marking out, cutting, deburring,
tacking together, welding, grinding, and finishing.
•	Knowledge in setting welding machines for different materials and weld joints.
•	Studying drawings and specifications to determine suitable material, method and sequence of
operations, and machine settings.
•	Fitting fabricated metal parts into products and assembling metal parts and subassemblies.
•	Checking fabricated and assembled metal parts for accuracy, clearance and fit using precision measuring instruments.
•	Interpreting work orders and determining the materials required. 
•	Problem-Solving: Identifying and addressing issues related to welding or material preparation
•	Maintain a high standard of workmanship and precision.
•	Log accurate records/documentation associated with your work as required and
•	Other duties as directed.
